new.quote: HARPER: You are insane, Jake, your own mother Diane murdered your grandmother Evelyn for this shipping empire!

prior.quote: DIANE: Looking for your late grandmother-in-law Evelyn's personal medical diary, twenty-four-year-old nurse Harper?

flags.explanation: Evelyn was previously established as Diane's mother-in-law (or late grandmother-in-law to Harper), but Harper incorrectly calls Evelyn Diane's mother.
flags.suggested_fix: Change 'your own mother Diane murdered your grandmother' to 'your mother-in-law Diane murdered your grandmother' or adjust the family tree.
